name: Real Spherical Harmonic Basis Functions
definition: Real spherical harmonic basis functions for degrees 0 through 3 in Cartesian space, incorporating the Condon-Shortley phase factor (-1)^m.
summary: Real Spherical Harmonic Basis Functions are real-valued, orthonormal directional bases that avoid complex arithmetic by combining standard complex functions, enabling efficient storage and evaluation of lighting in volumetric rendering.
